project.name: AI-Powered Product Specification Generator
project.description: This workflow transforms project ideas into production-ready documentation through conversational AI. Users describe their concept via chat, then AI agents progressively refine the scope, generate a comprehensive Product Requirements Document, and create a visual workflow diagram. The final deliverable is an exportable project bundle containing complete specifications and workflows that can be handed off to product managers and engineering teams for implementation.

prdSections.title: Overview
prdSections.content:
## Overview

- **Purpose**: Streamline product planning by transforming initial ideas into structured, shareable specifications through AI-assisted creation of PRDs and visual workflows
- **Primary Users**: Product managers, founders, and project leads who need to quickly translate concepts into actionable documentation for engineering teams
- **Problem Solved**: Eliminates the time-consuming manual process of writing comprehensive PRDs and mapping workflows, reducing project planning from days to minutes while ensuring nothing critical is missed
- **Key Value**: Produces standardized, exportable project bundles (.kiteframe format) that provide both written specifications and visual process maps, creating a single source of truth for implementation teams
- **Outcome**: Teams receive clear, complete project documentation that accelerates development timelines and reduces miscommunication between stakeholders and builders

prdSections.title: Requirements
prdSections.content:
**Functional Requirements:**

• **Multi-modal project input** supporting natural language chat interface for describing product ideas and iterative refinement through conversational AI agent
• **Automated PRD generation** producing comprehensive, structured documentation from user inputs and agent interactions
• **Visual workflow builder** that translates requirements into node-based process diagrams with automatic edge connections
• **Project bundling and export** creating portable `.kiteframe` packages containing PRD and workflow artifacts for team distribution

**Non-Functional Requirements:**

• **Response time** under 3 seconds for chat interactions and under 30 seconds for PRD/workflow generation
• **Cross-platform compatibility** with export bundles readable by standard project management and engineering tools without proprietary software dependencies

prdSections.title: User Flow
prdSections.content:
## User Flow

1. **Account Creation & Login** — User signs up and authenticates to access the platform
2. **Initial Idea Input** — User describes project concept through conversational chat interface
3. **Project Initialization** — System creates new project workspace with initial structure in a dedicated tab
4. **Iterative Refinement** — User collaborates with in-project AI agent to clarify scope, objectives, and requirements through dialogue
5. **PRD Generation** — AI produces comprehensive Product Requirements Document based on refined inputs
6. **Workflow Visualization** — AI automatically constructs visual workflow diagram with nodes and connections
7. **Bundle Export** — System packages PRD and workflow into single `.kiteframe` project bundle
8. **Team Handoff** — User shares exported bundle with product managers and engineering team
9. **Implementation Ready** — Team receives clear specifications and visual workflow for execution

**Note:** Steps 4-6 may involve iteration loops where users return to refine details before proceeding to export.

prdSections.title: Inputs & Outputs
prdSections.content:
## Inputs & Outputs

**Inputs:**
- User account credentials (email, password)
- Natural language project description via chat interface
- Refinement feedback and scope adjustments through AI agent conversations
- User approval/edits during PRD and workflow generation phases

**Outputs:**
- Structured project workspace with initial organization
- Comprehensive Product Requirements Document (PRD) in markdown format
- Visual workflow diagram with nodes, edges, and process flow
- `.kiteframe` project bundle containing PRD + workflow artifacts
- Shareable package ready for team handoff and implementation

**Data Flow:**
User input (chat) → AI-processed project structure → Generated documentation (PRD + workflow) → Exportable bundle → Team deliverable

prdSections.title: Failure Scenarios
prdSections.content:
# Failure Scenarios

- **Insufficient Initial Input**: User provides vague or incomplete project description during Prompt Chat, causing AI to generate unusable PRD/workflow requiring extensive rework
- **AI Generation Timeout**: Generate PRD or Generate Workflow nodes exceed processing limits for complex projects, resulting in partial outputs or complete failure
- **Refinement Loop Abandonment**: User exits Refine with Agent prematurely without confirming scope, leading to misaligned requirements in final deliverables
- **Export Bundle Corruption**: System fails to package complete PRD and workflow files, producing broken .kiteframe bundles that cannot be opened by recipients
- **Handoff Communication Gap**: Exported bundle lacks critical context or accessibility permissions, preventing PM/engineering teams from accessing or understanding deliverables

prdSections.title: Recovery & Fallback Paths
prdSections.content:
## Recovery & Fallback Paths

**AI Generation Failures**
- If PRD generation fails or produces incomplete output, user can re-prompt with additional context or manually edit the generated draft
- If workflow generation errors occur, system falls back to template-based workflow suggestion or allows manual node creation
- Chat and refinement agent timeouts trigger auto-save of conversation history with option to resume from last successful state

**Export & Handoff Issues**
- Failed bundle exports save individual PRD and workflow files separately for manual packaging
- Corrupted project bundles include JSON validation with error highlighting for manual correction
- Missing required fields in PRD trigger validation warnings before export, preventing incomplete handoffs

**Session & Data Loss**
- All project work auto-saves every 30 seconds to prevent data loss
- Browser crashes or logout preserve draft state with session recovery on next login
- Deleted projects remain in trash for 30 days with one-click restoration

prdSections.title: Operational Risks
prdSections.content:
## Operational Risks

- **AI Model Availability**: Dependency on third-party LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) creates risk of service outages or rate limiting during peak usage. Requires fallback providers and request queuing mechanisms.

- **Generation Performance**: PRD and workflow generation may take 30-90 seconds for complex projects. Need async processing with progress indicators and timeout handling (120s max) to prevent user abandonment.

- **Export Bundle Integrity**: File packaging process must validate completeness of PRD markdown and workflow JSON before download. Corrupted bundles would break handoff workflow; requires checksum validation and retry logic.

- **Concurrent Project Limits**: Users creating multiple projects simultaneously could exhaust AI quotas or database connections. Implement per-user rate limiting (3 active generations max) and queue management.

- **Session State Management**: Multi-step refinement conversations require persistent context storage. Session timeouts or lost connections risk data loss; auto-save draft state every 30 seconds to prevent rework.

prdSections.title: Acceptance Criteria
prdSections.content:
## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] User can create account, complete onboarding flow, and initiate new project via chat interface within 2 minutes
- [ ] AI generates complete PRD document containing all required sections (objectives, features, technical specs, timeline) from chat conversation within 60 seconds
- [ ] Visual workflow editor displays all project nodes with accurate connections and supports drag-to-reposition without breaking relationships
- [ ] Export function produces valid `.kiteframe` bundle containing PRD markdown, workflow JSON, and metadata that opens correctly when reimported
- [ ] Shared project bundles render identically for recipients regardless of their account tier or browser environment
- [ ] Given a project with PRD and workflow, when user clicks "Export Bundle," then download initiates within 3 seconds with file size under 5MB
